subject: spectre_haunt
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.
鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。

context.description_en: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
context.description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

scepter_loc.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

subject: treant_leech_seed
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: 该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。

context.description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
context.description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。

subject: undying_flesh_golem
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。

context.description_en: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
context.description_zh: 不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。

subject: wisp_equilibrium
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

context.description_en: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.
context.description_zh: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。

subject: medusa_stone_gaze
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: 被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。

context.description_en: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
context.description_zh: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过%face_duration%秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
notes_en: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.
notes_zh: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

subject: bristleback_quill_spray
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: 任何单位最近%quill_stack_duration%秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。

context.description_en: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 将尖刺喷射向敌人，对钢背兽附近的敌人造成伤害。任何单位最近%quill_stack_duration%秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。
notes_en: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 刺针扫射的伤害不能被伤害格挡类技能减免。

subject: tusk_tag_team
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed.
主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。

context.description_en: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续%debuff_duration%秒。
notes_en: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.
notes_zh: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。

subject: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被沉默，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被沉默，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。
notes_en: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
notes_zh: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。

scepter_loc.en: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

subject: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: 回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

context.description_en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
context.description_zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

subject: muerta_spectral_slug
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: 目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

subject: kez_echo_slash
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Heroes take bonus damage.
英雄会承受额外伤害。

context.description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
notes_en: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

subject: bloodstone
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
evidence: Spell Weakness Aura: Enemy units take 10% increased damage from spells.

abilities.description: Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.description:
Enemy units take 10% increased damage from spells. 

Radius: 1200

evidence: Spell Weakness: Cast a 900 radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take 10% increased damage from spells.

abilities.description:
Cast a 900 radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take 10% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: 16 seconds.

subject: bane_enfeeble

evidence: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。

context.description_en: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
context.description_zh: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。

subject: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror

复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。

context.description_en: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
context.description_zh: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。

subject: windrunner_focusfire
definition: 降低目标的攻击力
evidence: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.

context.description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
context.description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
notes_en: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

subject: tidehunter_anchor_smash
definition: 降低目标的攻击力
evidence: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage.
潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。

context.description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
context.description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
notes_en: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
definition: 降低目标的攻击力
evidence: Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

context.description_en:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.
context.description_zh:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加%stacks_per_attack%层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加%one_tooltip%层叠加效果。

subject: lycan_howl

context.description_en: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
context.description_zh: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。

subject: rubick_fade_bolt
definition: 降低目标的攻击力
evidence: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。

context.description_en: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
context.description_zh: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。

subject: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
definition: 降低目标的攻击力
evidence: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。

context.description_en: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
notes_en: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

subject: antimage_counterspell

evidence: 可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。

context.description_en: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
context.description_zh: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
notes_en: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。

shard_loc.en: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
shard_loc.zh: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

subject: sandking_burrowstrike

context.description_en: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
context.description_zh: 沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: lina_dragon_slave

evidence: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

context.description_en: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
context.description_zh: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
notes_en: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: lion_impale

evidence: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

context.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
context.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: death_prophet_carrion_swarm

evidence: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

context.description_en: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
context.description_zh: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: death_prophet_exorcism
definition: 使指向自身或队友的技能失效
evidence: Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。

context.description_en: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
notes_en: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
